title: Kaga Hyakumangoku Mystery Tour
notes: Detective-cast (Conan, Kogoro, Ran) omitted by convention except where their actions are the only stated source of an edge (kept minimal). case_type: attempted_murder (Akiyama survives, hospitalized overnight). No `event` node type: actions are direct typed edges. Discrepancies vs. the old cases/ file: (1) the old file's motive text says 'Kuranishi and an accomplice assaulted an elderly person' -- the transcript never mentions an accomplice; only Kuranishi is named as the true culprit of the 2010 assault-robbery, and a separate, different man was wrongly arrested for it four years later (the news report Akiyama reacts to). (2) the old file frames the code cards as simply 'secretly encoding details of that assault' -- the transcript is more specific: Akiyama had PRE-WRITTEN accusing code cards (dropped from her bag, recovered by Conan) that decode to '2010/5/6, case, culprit, Kuranishi-san' when combined, and lied about losing them, hastily writing innocuous replacement cards to hide the originals' existence while still routing the group through the same checkpoints. (3) the old file omits that Akiyama already knew Kuranishi was guilty and had stayed silent for years (implicitly complicit by concealment) while engaged to him, and only decided to confess after an innocent man was arrested for his crime -- Kuranishi attacked her specifically to stop that confession, using the commotion of a staged candid-camera 'thief' chase as cover, then stole her watch afterward because it contained a hidden camera he feared had recorded the attack.

clues.desc: Original code cards decode to '2010/5/6, case, culprit, Kuranishi-san' combined; the rewritten cards Akiyama handed out after claiming she'd lost the originals are innocuous checkpoint-only decoys -- the untouched originals, dropped from her bag at the crime scene, prove she was secretly accusing Kuranishi all along.

Akiyama was seen wearing her large watch throughout the tour but it was gone when she was carried to the stretcher; only Kuranishi touched her body afterward, feigning a pulse check -- he took it because it held a hidden camera he feared had filmed the attack.
